shots.loreNotes: Alien arms are not weapons he holds. They are part of him, and they arrive all at once. Physical sense: every water action has support — fighters stand on large sturdy lotus leaves or stone stepping stones, not on open water; the mahjong platform is wood, wide and stable, with chairs and a table on it; dropped weapons sink and spread rings; splashed water falls back under gravity; the ship moves on wheels and hull, not floating unsupported; shop interiors have floors, counters, and beams that hold weight.
